baseline.interpretation: Preserve the sealed review. Class competition is observed; causal contributions of dependence, rates, shrinkage and calibration remain unproved.

researchQuestion: Can independent changes to goal-distribution dependence, goal-rate estimation or multiclass calibration improve overall probability quality, rather than merely increase DRAW selections?

hypotheses.name: LOW_SCORE_DEPENDENCE_MODEL
hypotheses.mechanism: Permit explicit low-score joint dependence, including 0-0 and 1-1; Dixon-Coles-family correction is an example, not a selected implementation.
hypotheses.fitPolicy: Dependence coefficients fitted on development only, frozen before evaluation; v1 rates still update causally per target.
hypotheses.expectedEffect: Possible improvement in joint-score and multiclass probabilities; DRAW recall gain is not guaranteed.
hypotheses.failureRisk: No stable low-score dependence, invalid/negative mass, distortion of HOME/AWAY probabilities or development overfit.
hypotheses.falsification: Fails the fixed probability-quality screen, lacks valid normalized probabilities, or shows no preregistered low-score fit improvement.

hypotheses.name: GOAL_RATE_ESTIMATION_V2
hypotheses.mechanism: Separately specify team attack/defence, league baseline, venue effects and regularization for marginal goal-rate estimation.
hypotheses.fitPolicy: Freeze estimator and all hyperparameters before evaluation; team/rate state may refit at each cutoff using only the common eligible history. No evaluation-metric feedback.
hypotheses.expectedEffect: If rates are biased, better rates may improve multiple classes; reducing rates merely to chase draws is not an objective.
hypotheses.failureRisk: Sparse-team instability, overfit, faulty shrinkage or damage to non-draw probabilities.
hypotheses.falsification: Fails the fixed probability-quality screen or preregistered marginal-goal fit diagnostics.

hypotheses.name: MULTICLASS_CALIBRATION
hypotheses.mechanism: Fit one preregistered class-symmetric multiclass calibration transformation to v1 probability vectors, retaining ordinary argmax.
dataNeeded: chronological out-of-time development v1 probability vectors
development labels available under the fixed 48-hour research lag
hypotheses.fitPolicy: Never fit in-sample predictor vectors, evaluation labels or pooled leagues; fit calibration on development only and freeze before evaluation.
hypotheses.expectedEffect: Possible reliability/log-loss improvement without necessarily changing rare DRAW argmax behavior.
hypotheses.failureRisk: Leakage, insufficient calibration class counts, lost resolution or development overfit.
hypotheses.falsification: Fails the fixed probability-quality screen or worsens preregistered class calibration diagnostics.

split.unit: API_FOOTBALL providerFixtureId; exact identity, no fuzzy matching
split.membership: Hash-verified existing archives; provider season 2023 or 2024; FT Regular Season only. Round 1..38 for 39/140/135; 1..34 for 78. Existing Bundesliga Relegation Round exclusion is inherited, not newly optimized.
split.developmentFit: Season-2023 targets with kickoff before boundary; chronological out-of-time feature/probability generation, never full-season hindsight features.
split.developmentCheck: Season-2023 targets at/after boundary; fit coefficients only on fit-part labels available before boundary under 48-hour lag. No variant selection or parameter-grid expansion from check results.
split.finalDevelopmentFit: After the fixed development check, fit the same preregistered estimator on all season-2023 eligible out-of-time development examples whose research-availability precedes that league's first evaluation cutoff. Freeze H1/H3 coefficients and H2 hyperparameters before evaluation.
split.noOverlap: Development target IDs and evaluation target IDs must be disjoint globally. Both seasons are also checked against sealed evaluation target/status membership.
split.priorExposure: The 2024/25 labels/probabilities informed the existing structural review. This protocol is prospective relative to v2 execution, not relative to discovery of the problem. No unseen-test, causal-proof, validated-model or confirmatory significance claim is permitted.
split.newHoldout: An independent, not-yet-inspected cohort and separate prospective protocol are mandatory before any actual model promotion. No such cohort is selected, acquired or executed here.

temporal.eligibility: Same league, in-scope stage, distinct fixture ID; prior kickoff < cutoff; derivedResearchAvailableAt < cutoff; prior kickoff >= cutoff - 365 days.
temporal.developmentContext: Season 2023 only. No season-2022 ingestion or invented warmup. Early insufficient examples remain PASS.
temporal.evaluationContext: Season 2023 plus strictly earlier eligible season-2024 fixtures. Earlier evaluation outcomes may enter later target history only through the fixed causal update rule; never development selection, H1/H3 coefficient fitting or hyperparameter tuning.
temporal.simultaneousKickoffs: One immutable history per kickoff group; numeric fixture ID only orders output, never within-group training updates.
temporal.completionLimitation: 48 hours is an inherited retrospective assumption, not observed final-whistle evidence. Reliable contradictory evidence invalidates the affected experiment pending a new protocol; no selective repairs.
temporal.leagueIsolation: Separate fits, calibration and histories per league. No pooled labels, team mapping guesses, league-specific hand-selected specifications or EPL-result-driven changes. Same estimator specification applied independently.

experiment.coefficientFitting: Future deterministic fitting within a frozen estimator is allowed only after design approval; not performed in this mission.
experiment.jointDesignFreezeRequired: All three algorithm specifications, fixed hyperparameters, fitting objectives/constraints, initialization/seeds, convergence limits, class sufficiency gates, failure/PASS rules, numerical grid/normalization and mechanism diagnostics must be sealed together before any new development or evaluation output is viewed.
experiment.evaluationGate: Freeze candidate source hash, final development parameter hashes, input/cohort/protocol hashes and development report before evaluation. Baseline is the existing sealed v1 comparator; no v1 retuning.
experiment.noAdaptiveSelection: Report all three hypotheses, including failed/nonconverged ones. Do not use H1 results to redesign H2/H3. No winner ranking or combination choice from these exposed evaluation results.
experiment.abort: Leakage, hash/identity/cohort mismatch, nonfinite output or missing baseline-predicted candidate output blocks the screen; never silently remove that fixture. Corrections need a separately versioned protocol before a new run.

metrics.comparisonPopulation: All 1342 sealed v1 PREDICTED evaluation IDs, separately by league, fixed before candidate execution. Every candidate must predict every one; candidate PASS cannot shrink the denominator.
metrics.fullTargetAudit: Keep all 1446 targets and the original 104 v1 PASS records. Candidate coverage and additional predictions on these 104 are separately descriptive only, never added to primary paired metrics.
metrics.logLoss: mean(-ln(max(pActual,1e-15))); floor for scoring only, report floor-hit count
metrics.brier: mean(sum over HOME/DRAW/AWAY of (pClass - indicatorActualClass)^2); unscaled range 0..2
metrics.calibration: Per class and league: bins [lower,upper), final bin closed at 1; count, mean probability, observed frequency; n<20 low-sample. ECE=sum(nBin/n)*abs(meanProbability-observedFrequency). Retain empty bins with null means/frequencies.
metrics.classRule: Ordinary argmax, tie order HOME then DRAW then AWAY, unchanged for all candidates.
metrics.nullRule: Zero denominators => null, not zero. Invalid probabilities => INVALID, no evaluator repair. Stored probabilities finite in [0,1], sum within 1e-10 of 1.
metrics.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64, chronological kickoff then numeric fixture order, no rounding before comparisons.
metrics.aggregation: Each league is an independent mandatory primary report. No pooled accuracy or league-weighted winner score; no historical/Forward pooling.
metrics.inference: Descriptive preregistered screen only; no significance or confidence claim from the previously exposed season. Mechanism diagnostics cannot override primary failures.

promotion.probabilityGate: For EACH of all four leagues, candidate Log Loss < sealed v1 Log Loss - 1e-12 AND candidate Brier < sealed v1 Brier - 1e-12. Any worsening or failure to improve either metric in any league => screen NO, regardless of DRAW recall.
promotion.coverageGate: All fixed primary IDs predicted, no integrity failure, >=200 paired predictions and >=20 actual outcomes per class in each league; otherwise INVALID/INSUFFICIENT, never silently pool.
promotion.homeAwayGuard: For EACH league, overall accuracy and each HOME/AWAY recall may fall at most 0.02 absolute versus v1 (plus 1e-12 numeric tolerance). Each HOME/AWAY one-vs-rest Brier must not worsen beyond 1e-12.
promotion.calibrationGuard: For EACH league and each HOME/DRAW/AWAY class, ECE increase must be <=0.01 absolute plus 1e-12. Unknown required guardrail => insufficient, not a pass.
promotion.thresholdMeaning: These are prospective evaluation guardrails, not fitted model thresholds, weights, estimates of statistical power or claimed clinically/economically meaningful effects.
promotion.ifAllPass: Only a follow-up research candidacy label is allowed. All passing hypotheses are reported without choosing the best; actual PROMOTE remains NO until independent untouched-cohort protocol/results and separate CTO approval.
promotion.ifFail: Report failure unchanged. No recall-only success, manual league exception, offset, multiplier, new split, metric replacement or enlarged parameter search.

firewalls.baselineEvidence: Read-only, hash checked before/after; no existing archive/review/result edits.
firewalls.forward: Keep football-poisson-research-v1 and all forward runner/policy/input/snapshot/grade/scorecard files unchanged. V2 runner may not import or write operational Forward state. No Forward sample enters this historical study.
firewalls.marketComparison: Only a separately authorized post-seal analysis; none in this mission.
firewalls.changeControl: A new prospectively versioned hypothesis/protocol with explicit exposure history and approval is required; never relabel an outcome-driven rerun as the original preregistration.

hashPolicy: Companion Markdown records SHA256 of canonical JSON: recursively sorted object keys, original array order, compact JSON, UTF8, no newline. Cohort ID hashes use compact JSON of numeric IDs sorted by kickoff UTC then numeric ID. No per-fixture licensed data is published.
